articles.title: Senator Warren questions OCC chief on approval of ‘ineligible’ crypto trust charters
articles.snippet: The Massachusetts lawmaker asked the US Comptroller of the Currency to provide all communications between the agency and Donald Trump potentially related to the charter approvals.

articles.title: XRP price risks 50% drop despite 9-day ETF inflow streak
articles.snippet: Spot XRP ETFs record net inflows for nine days, absorbing sell pressure and potentially supporting an XRP price recovery over time.

articles.title: Estonian regulator partially suspends Zondacrypto operator license
articles.snippet: Estonia’s FIU has partially suspended BB Trade Estonia OÜ’s license, giving the Zondacrypto operator 30 days to fix compliance issues or risk full revocation.

articles.title: Bitcoin lost its hold on $80K, but three events may send it back sooner than markets expect
articles.snippet: Bitcoin positions itself for a rally above $80,000 after Strategy's $2 billion BTC buy, crumbling investor confidence in the US Treasury and a potential US-Iran deal.

articles.title: Bitcoin ETFs Shed $649M in a Day as Long-Term BTC Holders ‘Limit Downside Potential’
articles.snippet: U.S. spot Bitcoin ETFs posted $648 million outflows Monday as long-term BTC holders continue to accumulate the cryptocurrency.
